statement: Exact repeated request messages shall not create duplicate service records
A vehicle shall not receive overlapping assignments
acceptance_criterion: No overlapping intervals in audit output

statement: The demonstration scheduler shall complete at least 95 percent of synthetic fixed-fixture requests
acceptance_criterion: Served fraction at least 0.95 on fixed fixture

statement: The demonstration scheduler shall achieve p90 wait at most 20 minutes on the fixed fixture
acceptance_criterion: Nearest rank p90 no more than 20 minutes

statement: Every requirement and hazard shall have at least one linked verification test
acceptance_criterion: No missing or dangling local test links

statement: One-vehicle degradation shall be evaluated and reported as a separate scenario
acceptance_criterion: One vehicle fixture exposes failure of served target

statement: Invalid passenger count shall be rejected rather than silently accommodated
An ID reused for conflicting payload shall be rejected
